inputs: premium index klines for data completeness diagnostics only
mark price klines for funding valuation
data.quality_policy: fail before PnL on corrupt ZIP, hash mismatch, invalid or duplicate row, non-contiguous required 5m series, missing archive, or missing feature, execution, or funding valuation data
data.boundary_note: all observations end before the 2026-07-30 forward boundary and remain D0 development evidence

schedule.event_time: every 14 days from the frozen anchor
schedule.funding_information_cutoff: include realized funding events in (event_time - 14 days, event_time], because the portfolio waits for publication after event_time
schedule.decision_time: close of the complete 5m contract bar beginning at event_time
schedule.hold: 14 calendar days from each scenario's actual entry
schedule.overlap: successive portfolios are contiguous and non-overlapping within each execution scenario

features.funding_score: sum of realized funding rates strictly after event_time minus 14 days and through event_time
features.beta_model: OLS beta and residual volatility for each alt versus BTC using synchronized close-to-close returns from 8640 bars ending before event_time
features.liquidity_measure: sum quote volume over 8640 completed bars ending before event_time
features.capacity_measure: minimum quote volume over 12 completed bars ending before event_time
features.btc_trend_regime: sign of BTC log return over the prior 14 calendar days ending before event_time

portfolio.long_selection: three lowest trailing funding scores among the 12 most liquid alts
portfolio.short_selection: three highest trailing funding scores among the 12 most liquid alts
portfolio.sleeve_weights: inverse prior residual volatility, normalized to alt longs +0.5 and alt shorts -0.5
portfolio.btc_hedge: negative of selected alt prior beta exposure
portfolio.normalization: divide all signed alt and BTC hedge weights by total absolute weight
portfolio.projected_funding_return: sum of negative signed normalized leg weight times its trailing funding score
portfolio.threshold_reason: 24 bps equals the frozen stress round-trip fee plus slippage cost; no portfolio is opened when trailing carry does not cover that hurdle
portfolio.capacity_rule: reference notional times absolute normalized leg weight must not exceed 2% of the leg's frozen capacity measure; otherwise skip the whole event

execution.fees: charge every alt and BTC hedge entry and exit fill notional
execution.funding: include each actual funding transfer with leg_entry_time <= funding_time < leg_exit_time, valued at the mark-price 5m open at funding_time
execution.live_authorization: PAPER_ONLY; no live orders are authorized

interpretation.pass: eligible only for a new point-in-time full-universe replication and sub-minute execution replay; not eligible for live trading
interpretation.fail: eliminate this exact specification; any lookback, rebalance interval, hurdle, selection count, weighting, or holding-period change requires a new experiment id
interpretation.prohibited_claim: independent out-of-sample profitability or live-trading value
interpretation.known_bias: the fixed 16-symbol panel is survivor-selected and cannot support a deployable universe claim
interpretation.independence_rule: the biweekly portfolio is the observation unit; legs and funding settlements must not be counted as independent trades
interpretation.mechanism_rule: a pass requires actual funding transfers, after frozen fees and slippage, to be positive; price PnL alone cannot validate H6
